pricing_faq_q1: Does the 30-day trial require a credit card?
pricing_faq_a1: No. The trial starts right after you create your account — no card needed.
pricing_faq_q2: Can I switch plans during the trial?
pricing_faq_a2: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time before the trial ends.
pricing_faq_a3: Brazil: PIX, Boleto and card via Asaas. International: card via Stripe.
pricing_faq_q4: What happens when the trial ends?
pricing_faq_a4: Your account becomes inactive. Your data is kept for 30 days so you can subscribe.
pricing_faq_a5: Yes. No minimum commitment. Cancel from the dashboard and access continues until the end of the paid period.
